identity: A blue-black Domain Control deck that spends the domain counter on ANSWERS instead of threats. Leyline Binding is a flash catch-all that exiles any nonland permanent for {1}{W} at domain 4 and {W} at domain 5; Drag to the Bottom is a one-card board wipe at -5/-5 or -6/-6. Fourteen typed dual lands - seven different pairs, each producing blue or black - assemble the land types, and unlike the green build these duals do not all share a type, so the deck reaches domain 4 in 83% of games by turn five. Pixie Illusionist then closes the last step on demand: its tap ability makes a land you control become the basic land type of your choice until end of turn, converting one of the fourteen redundant Island or Swamp sources into whichever type is missing, at the exact moment a domain payoff resolves. Its sweepers are symmetric against its own board, so the threat count is deliberately low and the threats are deployed after the wipe. It wins with four resilient payoff copies: Sphinx of Clear Skies refills the hand on every connection, Sheoldred drains 2 on every opposing draw step without attacking, and two Tolarian Terrors cost {1} less per instant or sorcery in the graveyard.

sideboard.name: Soaring Drake
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fliers. Honest count: 41 pool cards mention flying but only 30 are flying creatures, and 16 of those 30 have power 3+ or toughness 4+, so a 2/3 body profitably blocks 14 of 30 — not the whole class. Sphinx of Clear Skies is already a maindeck flier, so this is the cheap supplement, not the only air defence.

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against the cube's 22-card lifegain class, which attacks this deck's secondary win condition specifically: Sheoldred's clock is 'Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life' at 2 per turn, and any of those 22 cards undoes several turns of it. 'Your opponents can't gain life' shuts all 22 off on a two-mana 2/2 with menace.

sideboard.name: Tidepool Turtle
sideboard.oracle_text: {2}{U}: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fast ground aggro. A 2/5 for four walls off most of the cube's early creatures, and '{2}{U}: Scry 1' turns surplus late mana into selection.

sideboard.name: Tribute to Urborg
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against creature decks that go under this deck's four-mana removal. '-2/-2 until end of turn', kicked {1}{U} for an additional -1/-1 for each instant and sorcery in your graveyard - 13 of the 22 nonland cards qualify after the Phase 9 repair, so the kicked mode scales into a real kill spell.

sideboard.name: Ertai's Scorn
sideboard.oracle_text:
This spell costs {U} less to cast if an opponent cast two or more spells this turn.
Counter target spell.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against spell-dense decks. 'This spell costs {U} less to cast if an opponent cast two or more spells this turn' makes it a one-mana hard counter on exactly the turns an opponent is trying to combo or double-spell past this deck.

sideboard.name: Negate
sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy, in against the cube's 18 enchantments and 15 artifacts. This deck's only maindeck answers to a resolved noncreature permanent are Leyline Binding and Negate itself, so countering on the way in matters.

sideboard.name: Ertai Resurrected
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When Ertai Resurrected enters, choose up to one —
• Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. Its controller draws a card.
• Destroy another target creature or planeswalker. Its controller draws a card.
sideboard.role: Flex — flash answer on a body
sideboard.when_to_board: In against decks with one key bomb, and in the control mirror. Flash 3/2 that on entry either counters a spell or ability, or destroys a creature or planeswalker — the opponent draws a card either way, which is an acceptable price on a two-for-one.

identity_es: Un control Domain azul-negro que gasta el recuento de domain en RESPUESTAS en lugar de en amenazas. Leyline Binding es un comodín con flash que exilia cualquier permanente que no sea tierra por {1}{W} con domain 4 y por {W} con domain 5; Drag to the Bottom es un barrido de tablero de una sola carta a -5/-5 o -6/-6. Catorce tierras duales con tipo — siete parejas distintas, cada una produciendo azul o negro — ensamblan los tipos de tierra, y a diferencia de la construcción verde estas duales no comparten todas un tipo, así que el mazo llega a domain 4 en el 83% de las partidas para el turno cinco. Pixie Illusionist cierra entonces el último paso a demanda: su habilidad de giro hace que una tierra que controlas se convierta en el tipo de tierra básica que elijas hasta el final del turno, convirtiendo una de las catorce fuentes redundantes de Island o Swamp en el tipo que falte, justo en el momento en que resuelve una recompensa de domain. Sus barredores son simétricos contra su propio tablero, así que el número de amenazas es deliberadamente bajo y las amenazas se despliegan después del barrido. Gana con cuatro copias de recompensa resistentes: Sphinx of Clear Skies rellena la mano en cada conexión, Sheoldred drena 2 en cada paso de robar rival sin atacar, y dos Tolarian Terror cuestan {1} menos por cada instantáneo o conjuro del cementerio.
